# FindAfriq

> A digital real estate and services platform that connects seekers with verified properties and trusted service providers across Africa, currently operating in Rwanda and Liberia.

FindAfriq lists three kinds of things: properties to rent, services to book, and
items or land for sale. Listings are created by landlords, agents, real estate
agencies and service providers, and are reviewed by an administrator before they
appear publicly — anything still pending or rejected is not served to visitors.

Prices are set by the owner in their own currency (USD or RWF) and are shown to
visitors converted into the currency they have selected. The figure a listing was
originally published at is displayed alongside the converted one on detail pages,
because FindAfriq does not process payments — the owner is the one who quotes.

Every public page exists at both `/en/` and `/fr/`, cross-linked with hreflang.
The two are the same content in different languages; prefer the locale that
matches the user and treat the other as a translation, not a separate page.
Listing detail pages carry schema.org structured data (`Accommodation` for
rentals, `Service` for services, `Product` for items for sale) with an `Offer`
and a `BreadcrumbList`.

## Browse

- [Properties](https://findafriq.com/en/routes/properties): rental listings, filterable by location, property type and budget
- [Services](https://findafriq.com/en/routes/services): service providers such as cleaning, electrical, plumbing and painting
- [Buy & Sell](https://findafriq.com/en/routes/buy-and-sell): land, houses and household items offered for outright sale

## About

- [How It Works](https://findafriq.com/en/routes/how-it-works): how seekers, landlords, agents and providers use the platform
- [About](https://findafriq.com/en/routes/about): what FindAfriq is and who runs it
- [Pricing](https://findafriq.com/en/routes/pricing): subscription tiers for seekers, listers and providers, billed in USD
- [Help Center](https://findafriq.com/en/routes/help): common questions

## Policies

- [Terms of Service](https://findafriq.com/en/routes/terms)
- [Privacy Policy](https://findafriq.com/en/routes/privacy)
- [Platform Policy](https://findafriq.com/en/routes/platform-policy)

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://findafriq.com/sitemap.xml): every public page and published listing, per locale
- [robots.txt](https://findafriq.com/robots.txt): crawl rules. Account areas — messages, notifications, bookings, saved listings and profile — are disallowed and require sign-in; they hold personal data and are not useful to crawl.
